calibration_sources: Microsoft Research LazyGraphRAG & LightRAG Cost-Quality Benchmarks vs. Full GraphRAG
Vector Database Filtered HNSW Search (Pre-Filtering Roaring Bitmaps vs. Post-Filtering Starvation)
Layout-Aware Parent-Child Chunking & Hybrid BM25 + Dense + Cross-Encoder Reranking Evaluations

workload.enterprise_scenario: 10,000-Employee Enterprise Knowledge Platform (1,000,000 Docs / 10M Chunks across SharePoint/Confluence/ERP with Row-Level RBAC/ACL; 85% Specific Lookups + 15% Cross-Doc Synthesis)
workload.target_sla: Blended Accuracy >= 93.0%, ACL Starvation/Leakage = 0.0%, P99 Retrieval Latency <= 250 ms, Freshness <= 10s
workload.key_architectural_insights: Never apply ACL permissions via Post-Filtering after Top-K vector search (causes 34% zero-result starvation); never run heavy LLM GraphRAG on 100% of simple lookup queries.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 朴素固定 500 字切块 + 纯向量检索 + 检索后置 ACL 过滤 (34% 权限饥饿零结果陷阱)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive Fixed Chunking + Dense Vector Only + Post-Filtering ACL (34% ACL Starvation)
tiers.rag_stack: 500-Char Fixed Split (Breaks Tables) + Dense HNSW Top-10 -> Post-Filter by User ACL
tiers.recommended_for: Toy single-user demos only; fails in enterprise production due to post-filter ACL starvation and broken tables.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 盲目对百万文档全量构建重型 LLM GraphRAG (建库贵 18 倍 · 单次检索慢达 2.45 秒)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Naive Full-Corpus LLM GraphRAG on 100% of Queries ($64K/mo Indexing & Map-Reduce Tax)
tiers.rag_stack: LLM Entity/Relation Extraction on 10M Chunks + Community Map-Reduce on Every Query
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for general enterprise search: wastes $50K+/mo running LLM graph extraction on routine docs and slows lookup queries by 20x.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 版面感知父子分块 + BM25/向量混合检索 + Reranker + 索引前置位图 ACL 过滤
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Layout Parent-Child + BM25/Dense Hybrid + Reranker + Pre-Filter Bitmap ACL + CDC
tiers.rag_stack: Docling/MinerU Table Markdown + 256/2048 Parent-Child + Pre-Filter Roaring Bitmap ACL + Reranker
tiers.recommended_for: Core enterprise RAG baseline: 0% ACL starvation, <3s CDC freshness, and 95.2% accuracy on specific fact/table lookups.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 自适应混合路由：Tier 3 混合检索 (85% 具体查询) + 轻量 LazyGraphRAG (15% 跨文档全局归纳)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Adaptive Router: Hybrid RAG (85% Lookups) + Selective LazyGraphRAG (15% Global Synthesis)
tiers.rag_stack: Tier-3 Hybrid Fast-Path (85% Traffic) + GLiNER/LazyGraphRAG Subgraph & Community Synthesis (15% Traffic)
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise knowledge platform gold standard: 95.8% accuracy across both needle-in-a-haystack and global thematic queries at 83.4% lower TCO than full GraphRAG.
